A single-cell layout wrapper preserves its nested data table as structured Markdown

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["brInTables" => true, "compactTables" => true]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>", $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
